note: Models whose _name carries 'payment' as a dotted component, each annotated with which of ADR-0068's nine senses it is -- or 'domain qualifier' where 'payment' qualifies a different head noun. `l10n_*` is exempt by rule and is not listed. Add an entry only with the category that justifies it; there is no --update.

models.account.batch.payment: settlement -- a batch of them, submitted to the bank as one file
models.account.payment.channel: channel -- a journal offering a method, booking to an outstanding account. Renamed from account.payment.method.line, which is not a document line
models.account.payment.method: method -- a capability: a code and a direction
models.account.payment.register.withholding.lin: wizard -- a withholding line the register wizard carries
models.account.payment.term: due schedule -- kept, though it is not a payment: ADR-0068 records why
models.account.payment.term.line: due schedule -- one step of one
models.account.payment.withholding.line: settlement -- a withholding line of one
models.hr.schedule.payment: due schedule -- a payroll pay period. The word order is reversed and agromarin is ungated for naming (workspace CLAUDE.md 9.4), so this entry is the only thing recording it
models.mixin.payment.qr.code: domain qualifier -- the head noun is the QR code
models.payment.method: provider method -- what the customer picks on the payment form, and the brands under it
models.payment.provider: domain qualifier -- the head noun is the provider
models.payment.token: domain qualifier -- the head noun is the token
models.pos.payment: settlement -- one taken at a till
models.sale.advance.payment.inv: wizard -- creates a down-payment invoice, not a payment
models.telegram.payment.report.log: domain qualifier -- the head noun is the log
models.test_orm.payment: test fixture -- demonstrates _inherits, and is named for what account.payment stopped being
